issues.description: Extracting `rankOf` moved the `[...scores].sort(...)` inside a function that is called once per player in `players.map(...)`. The full scores array is now copied and sorted N times (O(n * m log m)) where the original sorted exactly once outside the loop (O(m log m + n*m)). The refactor reads as a clean helper extraction, but it turns a one-time sort into a per-item sort. Sort once and pass the ranked array (or a precomputed rank map) in.
